name: Janusz Lewandowski - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Austria – EGF/2025/005 AT/KTM
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to release money from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. Austria asked for help after 1,488 workers lost their jobs at KTM, a motorcycle maker in Upper Austria. The fund will pay 1,806,624 euros, which is 60 percent of the 3,011,040 euro cost. The money pays for job advice, training, help finding work and training allowances for 420 of the former workers.

- The fund pays 1.8 million euros for job advice, training and job-search help for 420 former KTM workers.
- It affects former KTM workers in Upper Austria, where unemployment rose sharply after the company's insolvency.
- The decision takes effect once Parliament and Council sign it and it is published.
